verdict.rationale: 2FAS gives users explicit control over where data is stored (own cloud, external drive, self-hosting) and confirms no telemetry/tracking, which supports retention control (2fas-docs-5, 2fas-docs-14, 2fas-probe-rt-2). However there is no explicit documentation of a deletion/erasure workflow, data-retention policy, or account-deletion mechanism beyond implied local file control. Missing for 10: explicit data deletion/right-to-erasure documentation, retention period policy, and independent confirmation that deleting local/cloud copies fully removes data.
